If  you're  new  to  sales,  you  want  to  be  a 
 trash  man.  Let  me  explain.  In  companies 
 that  we  have,  we  like  to  do  something 
 called  lead  scoring.  Basically,  putting 
 an  approximation  on  how  likely  it  is 
 that  this  lead  closes.  You've  got  like 
 greens,  yellows,  and  reds.  And  so,  if 
 you're  a  new  salesperson  and  you're  not 
 getting  as  many  reps  with  the  green 
 leads,  then  ask  for  all  the  trash  leads. 
 Think  about  it  this  way.  You  are  going 
 to  get  free  training  from  the  hardest 
 leads,  which  are  the  best  training 
 grounds  for  you  to  learn  how  to  sell. 
 It's  a  reframe.  You  need  to  think  of 
 those  yellows  as  golds.
